What question or issue does this contribution address?

What changed, and what evidence or references support it?

Where relevant, does the change preserve the [COSSHAIC project roles and source commitments](https://github.com/loveandthermodynamics/research-program/blob/main/docs/cosshaic.md), and distinguish proposed authority/correction mechanisms from executed evidence?

For experiment contributions, link a completed [experiment record](https://github.com/loveandthermodynamics/research-program/blob/main/docs/experiment-template.md), including alternatives, costs, failures and reproduction instructions.

Describe any access, attribution or reuse terms that still need agreement. Do not include private personal data, credentials or source material you are not authorized to share.
